thread:
morgan: Heads-up — planning to push the lightweight engine shim + new quant profile to staging at 16:30 PT. Who can own the quick perf/sanity smoke?

devon: I can take the 16:30 window. Will run the perf harness and check tail-latency dashboards.

sanaa: I can validate correctness tests and run a few end-to-end prompts against the staging endpoint.

priya: I’ll watch infra metrics and stand by to flip the routing if we need to drain slices.

morgan: Thanks. Two notes: 1) this is a small-profile bump (fp16 -> 4-bit tuned), not a full kernel swap. 2) rollback path is the usual pin-to-prev-version.

kian: Can we list the exact smoke steps so people are aligned? I’ll prepare flags for quick revert.

morgan: Smoke checklist (short):
- confirm model loads without OOM
- run 10x small seq generation for p95 latency
- run 5 scripted eval prompts for hallucination/regression
- validate KV-cache warmup is stable
- sanity tail error rate < 0.5%

priya: Add infra checks: GPU memory/temperature, NVLink errors, pod restarts.

devon: I’ll post results in here as I run them. If p95 regresses >20% or errors spike, we rollback.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: staging-engine-shim-2751234567 by morgan at 2026-03-17T16:30:00Z

morgan: Rollback commands (short):
```
# pin service to previous engine image
redwoodctl set image inference-runtime --tag=engine-v2.9.1
# clear any sticky routing
redwoodctl rollout restart inference-svc
```

kian: PR is merged and labeled `deploy/staging`. I left a small note about a timeout tweak — not required for smoke but FYI.

sanaa: Quick Q: will the new quant profile change tokenization output? I’ll run token-level diffs.

morgan: No tokenization changes. Only weight quant format. Diffs should be identical aside from minor numeric variance.

devon: Starting perf runs now (kicking off harness). Will update with p50/p95 and error counts in ~8m.

priya: I’m on infra watch. Slack alerting set to high for GPU errors for the window.

morgan: If everything is green after 20m we can promote to canary domain later tonight. If anything weird, roll to v2.9.1 and we’ll debug.

devon: perf: p95 baseline 42ms -> new 49ms (17% up), p50 unchanged. errors 0.1% -> 0.4%. All within thresholds. Posting logs snippet.

morgan: Good — thanks. Sanaa, can you confirm eval prompts?

sanaa: evals look fine, diffs within tolerance. No hallucination regressions.

morgan: Great. Handing off to night crew for canary promotion at 22:00 PT unless rollback needed. Leaving note in runbook. :white_check_mark:
